title: Motley
summary: MOT'LEY, adjective [Eng.mote.] 1. Variegated in color; consisting of different colors; dappled; as a motley coat. 2. Composed of different or various parts, characters or kinds; diversified; as a motl

inlines.v: MOT'LEY, adjective [Eng.mote.] 1. Variegated in color; consisting of different colors; dappled; as a motley coat. 2. Composed of different or various parts, characters or kinds; diversified; as a motley style. And doubts of motley hue. [This word primarily means spotted; but it may signify also striped.]
